subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If a routing decision or worker outcome cannot connect to exactly one frozen/translated origin and attempt identity, then the system shall treat the attempt as failed and non-evidentiary, preserve its artifacts, and surface an audit-integrity escalation
intent: task is not counted succeeded; orphaned identity and missing edge named
fit_criterion: orphan, duplicate-terminal, and missing-origin fixtures never count toward M1/M4/M6 or release and never overwrite prior evidence
